angle: Shows how overestimating one's forecasting ability leads to higher turnover, greater transaction costs, and below-market returns.

title: Anchoring Bias in Stock Price Evaluation
angle: Details how an arbitrary reference price — a 52-week high, a purchase price — skews whether investors judge a stock as cheap or expensive.

title: Regret Aversion in Financial Decisions
angle: Covers the tendency to avoid actions that might lead to regret, causing investors to hold cash or stick with consensus choices even when alternatives are better.

title: Framing Effect and Investment Risk Perception
angle: Illustrates how presenting the same return or loss in different terms changes how risky investors perceive an identical investment.
